glosses: to hold (one's head) in one's hands
to be burdened with (e.g. care of a family member)
to have (children, etc.) to provide for

exampleTranslations.1: You should grab your bag and hurry home.
exampleTranslations.2: The Union of South Africa has had racial problems in recent years.
exampleTranslations.3: Young as he is, he has a large family to support.
